commentary.text: 90+12' Daniel Schlager is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+11' Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but he sends his header straight at the goalkeeper.
90+10' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) steps up to send the ball in.
90+10' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Koen Casteels, who smothers the ball.
90+10' Eintracht Frankfurt quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
90+9' Good work from Wolfsburg as they win a corner.
90+8' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
90+6' Eintracht Frankfurt fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
90+5' Aster Vranckx (Wolfsburg) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
90+4' Jean Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Koen Casteels intercepts the ball.
90+2' 2 - 2 Goal! Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 2:2.
90' 11 additional min. will be played.
90' Substitution. Elias Baum (Eintracht Frankfurt) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Buta walks off.
90' It will be a substitution. Timothy Chandler (Eintracht Frankfurt) is ready to enter the pitch as Ansgar Knauff walks off.
89' Niko Kovac has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Aster Vranckx (Wolfsburg) replacing Jonas Wind.
89' The linesman raises his flag. Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) is adjudged offside.
88' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
86' A cross by Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
86' Total attempts – 9:11.
84' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
82' The attendance for today's match is 58000.
81' Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg) is able to continue to play.
80' Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
80' PENALTY APPEAL by Eintracht Frankfurt, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
78' Niels Nkounkou (Eintracht Frankfurt) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
77' Dino Toppmoller is forced to make a change. Hugo Ekitike is unable to continue due to injury, Jean Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt) comes on.
76' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
75' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) misses a promising opportunity! He rises for a cross and unleashes a poor header from near the penalty spot. The ball floats high over the crossbar!
73' Niko Kovac has decided to substitute Kevin Behrens and he is replaced by Lukas Nmecha (Wolfsburg).
73' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Lovro Majer trots off the pitch and is replaced by Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg).

72' Kevin Paredes (Wolfsburg) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the middle of the target, but Kevin Trapp was alert and the score remains the same.
69' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the left post.
67' Here is a change. Donny van de Beek is going off and Dino Toppmoller gives the last tactical orders to Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt).
67' A substitution has been made. Philipp Max is replaced by Niels Nkounkou (Eintracht Frankfurt).
67' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
66' Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
64' Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
57' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Daniel Schlager no option but to blow his whistle.
57' The Eintracht Frankfurt players are exchanging some short passes.
55' 7:9 – the total goal attempt statistics.
53' The game gets underway again after that interruption.
46' The game is interrupted.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' Moritz Jenz (Wolfsburg) meets a cross on the edge of the box and gets his head on the ball, but it goes a whisker wide of the left post.
45+2' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
45+1' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Kevin Paredes (Wolfsburg), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg) wasted a great chance as he climbed high to connect with a cross from the free kick inside the penalty area. He produced a header, but sent the ball into the stands.
44' It must be a yellow card. It is. Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) receives the caution after an awful tackle.
42' The game is interrupted as Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) is flagged offside.
41' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) picked up a yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. He has to be careful for the remainder of the match.
40' Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Daniel Schlager had an easy-decision to make.
37' Referee Daniel Schlager signals that the goal stands after the VAR review and the Wolfsburg players have a reason to celebrate!
37' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Wolfsburg players aren’t happy.
36' 1 - 2 Goal! Kevin Behrens (Wolfsburg) makes the score 1:2 after burying a close-range header in the right side of the goal after a good run and cross by Joakim Maehle.
35' Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) goes on a mazy run and tries his luck with a mid-range strike, but one of the defending players steps in and makes a block.
32' Kevin Paredes (Wolfsburg) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
29' A rebound falls at the feet of Philipp Max (Eintracht Frankfurt) who unleashes a shot from long range towards the goal. However, his effort is poor and it flies high over the crossbar.
28' The resulting corner, taken by Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt), comes to nothing.
28' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The referee blows his whistle, Eintracht Frankfurt are awarded a corner kick.

25' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the middle of the goal, but Kevin Trapp pulls off an easy save.

24' Ambitious effort from Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar.
21' Kevin Behrens (Wolfsburg) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
21' Neat passing move from Wolfsburg in order to create new attacking opportunities.
20' The total number of attempts is 3:2.

14' 1 - 1 GOAL! Superb work from Hugo Ekitike, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Philipp Max (Eintracht Frankfurt), who beats Koen Casteels with a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner. 1:1.
13' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
12' The referee signals a corner kick to Eintracht Frankfurt.
12' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Eintracht Frankfurt have a corner.

11' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly low towards the middle of the goal, but Koen Casteels is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
10' Wolfsburg are ruled offside.
9' A pass from Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) is intercepted by Kevin Trapp and the move breaks down.
5' Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Daniel Schlager has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
4' Daniel Schlager sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
3' The Wolfsburg players halt their celebrations as referee Daniel Schlager makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a handball in the build-up play.
2' 0 - 1 It's a goal! Maxence Lacroix (Wolfsburg) does well to meet a cross inside the box and strikes a perfect header low inside the right post.
2' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) picked up a rebound and unleashed a fine effort which crashed against the right post.
2' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
